name: Fanaura
description: This document describes the HTTP surface of https://www.fanaura.com and the OAuth scopes for the MCP server at https://app.fanaura.com/mcp. Request public pages with Accept: text/markdown when you want Markdown. Request only the MCP scope the task needs. Canonical protected-resource metadata for the MCP server is https://app.fanaura.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Authorization server metadata is https://app.fanaura.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.
